objectives: Demonstrate fl-cycle recognition, decoding, spelling, word-family knowledge, comprehension and fluency.
Use component-level response evidence to identify a learning need.
concepts: A diagnostic samples different skills instead of repeating one item type.
Error patterns help identify a specific next teaching step.
Fluency includes accuracy and meaning, not speed alone.
Below-threshold results route to targeted remediation.

definitions.definition: A short assessment used to identify strengths and specific learning needs.
The minimum score required to advance.
Reading accurately and smoothly while preserving meaning.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads flag as fag.
workedExamples.solution: Record a decoding error involving the /l/ in the initial blend.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner spells flap as fap.
workedExamples.solution: Record an encoding error because l is missing.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads a sentence but cannot say where the flag is.
workedExamples.solution: Check comprehension and use of the location phrase as text evidence.

commonMistakes: Using one error to infer every skill is weak.
Scoring speed without accuracy or meaning.
Reusing the same questions in reassessment.
keyTakeaways: Sample recognition, decoding, encoding, word families, comprehension and fluency.
Use response patterns to select targeted practice.
Below 80% routes to targeted remediation and fresh reassessment.
revisionPoints: Decode the vowel and ending, not only the onset.
Use text evidence for literal answers.
Read accurately, smoothly and for meaning.

basic.prompt: Name a word that begins with fl.
What are the first two sounds in flap?
What is the rime in flat?

conceptual.answer: To identify strengths and specific learning needs.

conceptual.prompt: How many correct answers out of 15 meet 80%?

conceptual.answer: Accurate smooth reading must preserve what the sentence says.

application.prompt: If flag is read as fag, what skill needs support?
If flap is spelled fap, what skill needs support?
What happens below the mastery threshold?

higherOrderThinking.answer: It identifies the specific skill needing support.

higherOrderThinking.prompt: How can a learner support a literal answer?
higherOrderThinking.answer: Point to the exact words in the sentence.

higherOrderThinking.prompt: Why use fresh items after remediation?
higherOrderThinking.answer: To check transfer rather than memorised answers.

mixedReview.prompt: What is a safe next step after a below-threshold result?
mixedReview.answer: Target the weak component, practise and reassess with fresh items

steps: Review responses across recognition, decoding, encoding, word families, comprehension and fluency.
Route by the 80% threshold and note weak components.

questions.question: Which word begins with the blend fl?
What are the first two phonemes in flap?
What is the rime in flat?
Which word does not begin with fl?
If flag is read as fag, what should the reader do?
options: Add a vowel between f and l

questions.question: Read: “The flag is on the mat.” Where is the flag?
Which order matches the controlled passage?
options: Ben has a flag; the flag is on the mat; Ben can flap it
Ben flaps the flag; then Ben gets a flag; then the flag appears
The flag is flat; Ben has a flag; the flag is on the mat
The flag is lost; Ben has a cap; Ben finds a flag

questions.question: Which description best matches fluency?
options: Accurate, smooth reading that keeps meaning
Fast reading even when sounds are skipped

questions.question: What is the onset in flit?
If a learner scores 10 out of 15, what route applies?
options: Targeted remediation because the score is below 12/15
Repeat the same questions until memorised

questions.question: Why review a response pattern instead of one missed item?
options: It shows which component needs support
It means every skill is weak
It removes the need to teach

answerKeys.explanation: The /l/ in the initial blend was omitted.
The sentence states that the flag is on the mat.
This sequence follows the passage details.
Fluency includes accuracy, smoothness and meaning.
Ten is below the 80% threshold of 12 correct.
Patterns provide better evidence for choosing a targeted next step.
